title: Task preparation
description: Tasks are prepared as batches (JSON) for MT, ASR, and TTS. Understanding who can prepare them, what types exist, and what to include ensures evaluations run smoothly. Batches can be uploaded from the Datasets page or created through the API.

subsections.title: Who can prepare a task and how

items: Administrators (or users with upload permission) can create and upload batches via the Datasets page.
Batches are uploaded as JSON; the schema is the same for MT and ASR except for language fields and the type of input (text vs. audio URL/path).

subsections.title: Types of tasks: MT and ASR

items: MT: each task has a source segment (input) and one or more translation hypotheses (model outputs).
ASR: each task has an audio input (URL or path) and one or more transcription hypotheses. ASR evaluations are batch-based.
MT: add source_language and target_language. ASR: add language.

blocks.text: Each task: id, input (source text for MT, audio URL or path for ASR), models (array). Each model: output (text), model (string identifier), rate (number, use 0 when preparing), rank (number, use 0).

items: rating_guideline: if not provided, the default 1–5 scale is used (Critical, Major, Minor, Neutral, Kudos).
domains: if not provided, no domain dropdown is shown; evaluators can still complete the task.
task_models_shuffles: if not provided, model identifiers in the batch are shown as-is.
Per-task reference: optional; evaluators can add a reference in the UI when needed.

blocks.text: input is the source segment; each model output is the translation. rate and rank are set by evaluators; use 0 in the upload.
input must be a URL or path to the audio. Use language instead of source_language and target_language.
TTS batches must declare a workflow, and it decides what annotators do with the batch.

items: annotation (voice collection): each task is a text prompt for the annotator to read aloud. The recording is saved on the task, so tasks carry no model outputs.
evaluation (model comparison): each task has text to synthesize plus model outputs pointing at audio, rated and ranked like MT and ASR.

blocks.text: A TTS batch without workflow is rejected at upload.
input is the prompt to read aloud. Leave reference empty — it is filled in with the annotator's recording. Do not include models.

Batches do not have to be uploaded by hand. The API accepts the same batch JSON and applies the same validation, so an offline pipeline can create batches, assign them, and pull results without anyone touching the Datasets page.

items: Create an API key from your profile session, then send it as an Authorization: Bearer heval_... header.
Ask the server for the shape you need: GET /api/v1/templates/{mt|asr|tts} returns required fields and a worked example per workflow.
Create the batch with POST /api/v1/batches, then assign an annotator with POST /api/v1/batches/{batchId}/assign.
Append more tasks at any time with POST /api/v1/batches/{batchId}/tasks — the batch can grow while it is being worked on.
Collect results with GET /api/v1/batches/{batchId}/results, or the full data with .../export.

blocks.text: Appending is restricted to the batch creator (or an admin), and is all-or-nothing: if a task id already exists in the batch, nothing is added. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry after a dropped connection cannot add the same tasks twice. Tasks added to a batch someone already has open appear the next time they load that batch.
A Python client wrapping these endpoints lives in clients/python; its README has a worked voice-collection example.

blocks.code:
from horneval import HornEval

client = HornEval()  # reads HORNEVAL_URL / HORNEVAL_API_KEY

batch = client.create_batch(
    dataset_type="tts",
    batch_name="tir-voices-2026-08",
    dataset_domain="general",
    language={"iso_639_3": "tir", "iso_name": "Tigrinya"},
    workflow="annotation",
    tasks=[{"id": "p1", "input": "ሰላም ከመይ ኣለኻ።"}],
)

# Feed the batch more prompts as they are produced
client.append_tasks(batch["batch_id"], [{"id": "p2", "input": "ጽቡቕ መዓልቲ።"}])
